name: Comarch e-Invoicing
summary: Comarch connects to national platforms such as Poland's KSeF, Italy's SdI, France's PDP and Romania's e-Factura. It describes itself as a certified Peppol Access Point, and its e-archive stores sent and received invoices for the legally required period. It publishes no prices.

facts.text: Comarch lists supported formats including XML, ZUGFeRD, UBL BIS 3.0, IDOC and EDIFACT. It says it connects to government platforms including SDI, PDP, KSeF and RO e-Factura.
The page calls Comarch a certified PEPPOL Access Point and says it is a member of OpenPEPPOL.
The e-archive section says it stores and manages all sent and received invoices for the legally required period.
The page says Comarch is trusted in more than 60 countries.
The page gives no prices. It says the final cost depends on document volume, the number of countries and integration complexity.
